This spot is really good if you want to go to Albi (Tarn), or even to Rodez (Aveyron).
I usually wait less than 5 min there, and often get a direct ride to my final destination.
To reach this spot, you need to take the subway/bus to Argoulets and then take the bus 68 (towards Castelmaurou) and stop at D59. Then, you have to cross the toll booth to reach the other side and wait (with a thumbs up) just before the rest area.

The public transport trip took about an hour and costs 7,50 pp. We think it's worth the effort, considering the fact that we had a tent to camp at the station. From survilliers it's about 30 minutes walking through the industrial areas, which was quite scet

Excellent spot for entering the countryside, but not necessarily worth the risk of going through this area of France, pretty much exclusively local traffic who will only be going very short distances, and very few cars at that. I live in this area and have seen many hitchhikers end up stranded from the lack of vehicles.
I'd only recommend getting in a car going at minimum to Villefranche de Rouergue if hitching west from here.
Personally found a man heading to cahoots very quickly however. 
W

I gave up and got a ride into the city of Montpellier (which was easy).

Though, it took me a long while to catch a ride. Bad-hair day?:)

However, finding a car that goes far might be more up to luck. Your chances of finding a car that crosses the country are high during summer however (with people coming back from vacations).
